subject: Meteorology
title: Dew Point and Saturation
description: A fast breakdown of Dew Point and Saturation for builders.

hook.text: Cool air enough and water vapor starts condensing—the temperature where this happens is the dew point.

buildup.text: When air temperature equals the dew point, relative humidity hits 100%—the air is saturated.

discovery.text: Rising air cools at a predictable rate—so the height where it reaches the dew point is the cloud base.

twist.text: You can estimate cloud base height from the surface dew point spread: each 2.5°C gap ≈ 300 m of altitude.

climax.text: Pilots and forecasters use this trick daily—a large spread means high clouds, a small spread means low fog risk.

punchline.text: The dew point tells you where clouds begin.
